service.name: document-manager
service.description: Local-first document ingestion and understanding: tiered parsing, citable anchors, sensitivity-aware routing, and a per-document custody receipt

doc-parse.description: Local content, table, geometry, and PDF classification handler for intake and derivation.

doc-ocr.description: Portable tier-2 OCR handler for scanned PDFs and raster images.

unstructured-io.description: Measured Docker fallback for breadth, typed elements, and OCR when available.

ai-gateway.description: Gateway-only inference seam for later enrichment and permitted remote tiers.
ai-gateway.degraded_behavior: Intake and local parsing remain available; enrichment and permitted remote tiers are unavailable until ai-gateway starts.

storage-manager.description: Governed storage and routed file-store contract for raw bytes.
storage-manager.degraded_behavior: The scenario keeps its local routed storage seam; external storage-manager-backed operations are unavailable until storage-manager starts.

search-hub.description: Retrieval registration and query seam used by later domains.
search-hub.degraded_behavior: Intake and local parsing remain available; retrieval registration and federated search are unavailable until search-hub starts.

raw_documents.rationale: Original content-addressed document bytes; never pruned or regenerated.

budget.rationale: Derived readings are reproducible from the durable raw bytes.

derivations.rationale: Versioned parser output may be rebuilt after retention.

budget.rationale: The FTS and vector index is rebuildable from units and enrichment metadata.

retrieval_index.rationale: Retrieval state is a derived cache and is never the source of corpus truth.

custody.rationale: Append-only processing evidence; no prune budget by design.

deployment.rationale: Lifecycle deployment reports are durable operational evidence retained with the scenario data root.

storage.rationale: Raw bytes and custody evidence are durable; derivations are reproducible cache artifacts.
